english.title: Fail to furnish information / book / article to enable the determination of duty payable and drawback payable
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with a requirement made under section 133(5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979

(A)_[to furnish the necessary information to enable the Commissioners to determine whether duty has been duly paid and not drawn back and for enabling a calculation to be made of the amount of drawback payable]_
(B)_[to produce a book of account or other document relating to the goods or article, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS / ARTICLE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 133(5) and (6) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
